name: Nyar'zathul, the Crawling Dream
ability: This unit is also a nexus token; it cannot be affected by abilities that place or move nexus tokens. If it is removed using INCOMPREHENSIBLE FORM, produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponent's ships.

name: The Recurring
ability: When this unit would be destroyed, you may spend 1 influence to instead place it in a system that contains a nexus token.

name: Liturgy I
ability: At the end of a tactical action in this unit's system, you may place or move 1 nexus token into this system.

name: Liturgy II
ability: At the end of a tactical action in this unit's system, you may place or move 1 nexus token into a non-home system that contains 1 or more of your ships and no other player's ships.

name: The Fractal
ability: When this unit is destroyed, you may return a number of captured fighters from your faction sheet up to the capacity value of this unit to place 1 ship in this system with a cost up to the amount of fighters returned.

name: Refractum
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of ground combat, you may return 2 captured fighters to place 1 mech from your reinforcements on that planet.

name: Shard Swarm
ability:
This unit may move without being transported. Fighters in excess of  your capacity count against your fleet limit.

When this unit is destroyed, capture it. At the start of your turn, you may place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in any system that contains a planet you control.

name: The Pyre
ability: During your tactical actions, for each infantry destroyed by this unit's BOMBARDMENT ability, place 1 captured infantry from your faction sheet on that planet.

name: Balefire Sentinel
ability: When this unit would be destroyed, place it on this card. At the start of your next turn place each unit on this card on planets you control in your home system.

name: Ashfall Engine I
ability: During combat, when this unit is destroyed, you may use its BOMBARDMENT ability against a planet in its system.

name: Ashfall Engine II
ability:
This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards.

During combat, when this unit is destroyed or uses its SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability, you may use its BOMBARDMENT ability against a planet in its system.

name: Cinderborn II
ability: DEPLOY: At the start of a round of ground combat on a planet you control, you may place 1 captured infantry on that planet.

name: Iron Dominion
ability: Once per combat round, after 1 of your other non-fighter ships is destroyed in this system, you may repair 1 of your damaged units in this system.

name: Exo-Forge
ability: This unit's PRODUCTION value is equal to half the resource value of its planet, rounded up.

name: Tideyard I
ability: DEPLOY: At the end of a tactical action, you may remove 2 of your mechs from the active system to place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control in the active system. Up to 4 fighters in that system do not count against your ships' capacity.

name: Tideyard II
ability: DEPLOY: At the end of a tactical action, you may remove 2 of your mechs from the active system to place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control in the active system. Up to 8 fighters in that system do not count against your ships' capacity.

name: Worldshaper
ability: 1 planet of your choice in this system you control has its resource and influence values increased by 1, and 1 planet of your choice in this system controlled by another player has its resource and influence values reduced by 1.

name: Valuator
ability: DEPLOY: When you attach a card to a planet, you may spend 1 resource to place a mech on that planet.

name: Mi-Dum
ability: When this unit makes a combat roll, it rolls 1 additional die for each red technology your opponent owns.

name: Nimda
ability: DEPLOY: When you gain a technology, you may place a mech from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: The Chained
ability: This unit's movement is not affected by anomalies. During a combat in The Fracture or an anomaly, apply +2 to the result of each of this unit's combat rolls.

name: Schism
ability: This unit's system is an anomaly.

name: Sleipnir
ability: When you roll SPACE CANNON, treat each system that contains your PDS as adjacent to this system. This unit’s SPACE CANNON is equal to 10 minus the number of your PDS units on the game board.

name: Heimdallr
ability: DEPLOY: When a player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your PDS units, you may place 1 mech with that unit.

name: Bilröst I
ability: During the “Commit Ground Forces” step of an invasion in this or an adjacent system, you may commit up to 1 ground force from this unit’s planet.

name: Bilröst II
ability: During the “Commit Ground Forces” step of an invasion in this or an adjacent system, you may commit up to 1 ground force from this unit’s planet or an adjacent planet.
